subject: route-b.DR-008.preview-disposition.v1
protocol: Independent review under D-000; refute not confirm; Route B pre-blueprint disposition draft for DR-008's EVIDENCE/D9 integration half, architecture-preview scope
summary: The posture half is not reopened — the artifact carries a dedicated postureHalfUntouched block pinning the applied retention head and listing the four closed items, and whatThisDoesNotDo repeats the refusal. The half is correctly confined to the EVIDENCE/D9 integration, selection and recording are separated with the owner cell matching file 08, and nothing is pretended settled. Its strongest feature is one I did not expect and verified in full: it discloses a live register-cell lag rather than quietly relying on it. File 08's DR-008 cell still recites the retained checker as UNREVIEWED, and the artifact records that the measured standing is ACCEPT-STANDING at 0 blockers with the review digest named, then classifies that lag as environment rather than as part of its own close and declines to repair it — which is correct, since repairing it would be an MF-6 register-content act. Every element of that disclosure checks out at bytes. One advisory, on a foreclosure clause its sibling carries and this one does not.

findings.claim: The condition-1 clause forecloses self-recording by existence but not by independent review, where the sibling DR-005 disposition in the same dispatch forecloses both. The omitted route is live, because this review is issuing an ACCEPT on the artifact.
findings.evidence: condition1EffectIfOwnerRecorded ends: 'This file existing is not owner recording.' The parallel clause in route-b.DR-005.preview-disposition.v1 at 6d33037cd2ffbb6080ac359aa2b87a8b3f1c2edc0fe4210291792285263f67ce ends: 'This file existing, or an ACCEPT verdict, is not owner recording.' The three dispositions in this dispatch are otherwise built to the same template, so the difference is an omission rather than a deliberate distinction. It matters here more than it would in the abstract for two reasons. First, condition 1 requires that 'the owning V1 authority records' the disposition, and the artifact correctly names the evidence/retention authority as that owner while noting D-000 does not make the coordinator that authority — so the whole point of the clause is to keep a non-owner act from being mistaken for the owner act, and an independent-review ACCEPT is exactly the non-owner act now in flight. Second, this corpus has already adjudicated the adjacent confusion in the opposite direction: DR-204 ruled the 2026-08-12 DR-001 SATISFIED provenance-unlawful because it lacked independent review, and the register's own DR-002 note records that a green checker or a passing review is author-side evidence only. A reader who has internalised 'review is what makes it lawful' is precisely the reader who might treat an ACCEPT as the recording. Nothing in the artifact is false; the clause is simply narrower than its sibling's and narrower than the risk.
findings.proposedFix: Adopt the DR-005 wording verbatim: 'This file existing, or an ACCEPT verdict, is not owner recording.'

whatIVerified: Subject digest at start and end: e989530ff04c2c617ea91b632e975b24f5a644dacf788edf7232a006de9fe772 both times. No drift.

The posture half is not reopened, which is the axis the prompt names for this artifact. The half field reads 'EVIDENCE/D9 integration half only'. postureHalfUntouched pins the applied head retention-tiers.v28 at e622b3cc19ba6a550348d849eedf5867e27a0302800b5b705a57e3bb611f9de2 — which I re-measured and confirm — lists the four closed items as posture, defaults, bound independence and PURGED-not-deleted semantics, and sets thisArtifactDoesNotReopenThem true. whatThisDoesNotDo repeats 'Does not reopen the posture half.' Those four closed items match adopted D-032's own recital that posture, defaults, bound independence and PURGED-not-deleted semantics are closed.

The register-cell lag disclosure is accurate in every element, and I checked each rather than accepting the claim. The artifact states that file 08's DR-008 cell still recites the retained checker as UNREVIEWED: true — the cell contains 'check-retention-custody-v28.py` **UNREVIEWED'. It states the measured standing at authoring is ACCEPT-STANDING at 0 blockers with review digest 3b548c287e8d21d5ff3462af218e5b8a9461bb72d0d2302f2cae767cec4e8dd2: the file at that path measures exactly that digest, and the freeze records 'INDEPENDENTLY REVIEWED — **ACCEPT-STANDING, 0 blockers, 10 advisories**' for it. It classifies the lag as 'environment, not this half's close, and is not repaired here', which is the correct disposition — repairing a file-08 cell is an MF-6 act this artifact is not. The artifact omits the '10 advisories' figure the freeze carries, which is not a misstatement since the claim is about standing rather than advisory count, and I record it here rather than as a finding.

Nothing settled is pretended. whatMustNotBePretendedSettled names the EVIDENCE/D9 join itself, the §3.1 Phase-1A insertion, authoritative offline closure and a sealed Run carrying PURGED. whatRemainsOwedOnRouteA names the evidence-side successor consuming retention together with Phase-1A, the §3.1 supplier-coverage instrument routed to Lane R rather than to this disposition, and the full V10, G19 and publication-block demonstration with the note that neither D-028 nor this entry discharges it.

The coordinator is not treated as the owner. ownerWhoMustRecord reads 'evidence/retention authority (contract half). Product owner remains the posture owner. Coordinator may draft. D-000 does not make the coordinator those authorities', which matches file 08's DR-008 owner cell — 'Product owner (`sfbreen`) for posture; evidence/retention authority for contract' — including the split between the two owners.

No silent SATISFIED. Three occurrences: the authority claim's 'records nothing as SATISFIED', whatThisDoesNotDo's 'Does not mark DR-008 SATISFIED', and a statusAtAuthoring recital of 'PARTIALLY SATISFIED' which is a factual quotation of file 08's current DR-008 row status rather than a claim about this artifact's effect.

verdictNote: ACCEPT-WITH-ADVISORIES. The substance survives attack on every axis, and the register-lag disclosure is the best thing in the artifact: it names a defect in a document it is not authorized to fix, states the measured truth with a digest, and classifies the lag honestly rather than either ignoring it or relying on it. Every element of that disclosure verified at bytes. The single advisory is one clause, available verbatim from its own sibling, and it closes the one route by which this verdict could be mistaken for the owner recording condition 1 requires.
